  #script-preview {
    font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; white-space: pre-wrap;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px; max-height: 42vh; overflow-y: auto;
    flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 100px;
  }
  .start-bottom { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
  .start-tip { font-size: 12px; color: var(--dim); text-align: center; line-height: 1.5; }
  .btn-primary {
    width: 100%; padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; border: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c8a2ff 0%, #8c5cf6 100%); color: #fff;
    font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 28px -10px rgba(140,92,246,0.55);
  }
  .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
  .err { color: var(--red); font-size: 13px; text-align: center; padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(255,59,48,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255,59,48,0.25); border-radius: 10px; }

  /* QR section — "Open on phone" */
  .qr-section {
    margin-top: 14px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
    padding: 14px 14px 14px 16px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius: 16px;
  }
  .qr-section.hidden { display: none; }
  .qr-info { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
  .qr-label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
  .qr-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); }
  .qr-tip { font-size: 11px; color: var(--dim); line-height: 1.4; }
  .qr-canvas {
    width: 96px; height: 96px;
    background: #fff;
    padding: 6px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    flex: 0 0 96px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .qr-canvas img { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; image-rendering: pixelated; }
  @media (min-width: 560px) {
    .qr-canvas { width: 128px; height: 128px; flex-basis: 128px; }
  }

  /* ================ RECORD SCREEN ================ */
  #stage { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: #000; }
  #camera {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; background: #000;
  }
  #camera.mirror { transform: scaleX(-1); }

  /* Tiny "↑ camera" dot at top center — reminds where to look */
  #lens {
    position: absolute; top: max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-top)); left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 5;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    padding: 5px 11px 5px 9px; border-radius: 999px; pointer-events: none;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    transition: opacity 0.3s;
  }
  #lens .dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent); }

  /* Corner buttons */
  .corner { position: absolute; z-index: 9; }
  .corner.tl { top: max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-top)); left: 10px; }
  .corner.tr { top: max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-top)); right: 10px; }
  .icon-btn {
    width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; border: 0;
    background: var(--glass); color: var(--fg);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  .icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.94); }
  .icon-btn.on { color: var(--accent); border-color: rgba(177,140,255,0.4); }

  /* Prompter window — anchored to the very top edge of the screen so the dark gradient
     starts at the top and fades seamlessly into the camera feed. No hard horizontal edge. */
  #prompter-window {
    position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0;
    top: 0;
    height: 58vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    /* Fade the bottom edge to transparent so lines dissolve into the camera below */
    mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0%, #000 72%, transparent 100%);
    -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0%, #000 72%, transparent 100%);
  }
  /* Soft dark vignette — strongest at top, fully clear by the bottom of the window */
  #prompter-window::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.62) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 28%, rgba(0,0,0,0.28) 55%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #prompter {
    position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0;
    /* Top padding reserves space for the "↑ camera" pill so first line clears it */
    padding: calc(max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) + 48px) 22px 60vh 22px;
    text-align: center;
    will-change: transform;
  }
  .line {
    font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.28; margin: 0 0 0.45em;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
    text-shadow:
      0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.95),
      0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.85),
      0 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }

  /* Read-zone glow — subtle horizontal accent + arrow pointing up at the lens */
  #readzone {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 56px; height: 0;
    border-top: 2px solid var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--accent), 0 -2px 12px var(--accent);
    border-radius: 2px; pointer-events: none; z-index: 4;
    opacity: 0.85;
  }

  /* ================ BOTTOM CONTROL BAR ================ */
  #controls {
    position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    padding: 10px 16px calc(max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) + var(--badge-clearance));
    z-index: 8;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 10px;
    background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.72) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.42) 60%, rgba(0,0,0,0.0) 100%);
  }
  .control-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; }
  #reshoot, #settings-btn { width: 48px; height: 48px; font-size: 18px; background: var(--glass); }
  #reshoot { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--fg); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); }
  #settings-btn { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--fg); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); }
  #reshoot:active, #settings-btn:active { transform: scale(0.94); }

  /* Live sliders — sit above the button row, always visible during recording.
     Stacked vertically on phone screens so SIZE never gets clipped; side-by-side on tablet+. */
  .live-sliders { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 0 4px; }
  @media (min-width: 560px) { .live-sliders { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } }
  .live-slider {
    flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    background: var(--glass);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 7px 14px;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .live-slider label {
    font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); min-width: 32px;
  }
  .live-slider input[type=range] {
    flex: 1; accent-color: var(--accent);
    height: 18px; min-width: 0; background: transparent;
  }
  .live-slider .val { font-size: 10px; color: var(--fg); min-width: 28px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: 0.85; }

  #rec-btn {
    width: 78px; height: 78px; border-radius: 50%;
    border: 4px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
    background: var(--red);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    position: relative;
  }
  #rec-btn .core {
    width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--red); transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }
  #rec-btn[data-rec="true"] .core { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; }
  #rec-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

  /* Recording indicator — lives inside #controls (above the sliders), out of the prompter area */
  #rec-indicator {
    align-self: center;
    background: rgba(255,59,48,0.96); padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    display: none; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }
  #rec-indicator.show { display: inline-flex; }
  #rec-indicator .dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; animation: blink 1s infinite; }
  @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0.25; } }

  /* Countdown overlay */
  #countdown {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; display: none;
    align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); z-index: 20;
  }
  #countdown.show { display: flex; }
  #countdown .num {
    font-size: 200px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff;
    text-shadow: 0 8px 60px rgba(177,140,255,0.65), 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    animation: pop 0.9s ease;
  }
  @keyframes pop { 0% { transform: scale(0.6); opacity: 0; } 30% { transform: scale(1.0); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: scale(0.9); opacity: 0; } }

  /* ================ SETTINGS SHEET ================ */
  #settings-sheet {
    position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(20,20,22,0.94);
    backdrop-filter: blur(28px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px);
    border-top-left-radius: 28px; border-top-right-radius: 28px;
    padding: 12px 20px max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    z-index: 30;
    transform: translateY(100%); transition: transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  #settings-sheet.open { transform: translateY(0); }
  .handle { width: 36px; height: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); border-radius: 999px; margin: 0 auto 14px; }
  .sheet-title { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 14px; text-align: center; }
  .setting { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
  .setting:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .setting-label { font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg); flex: 0 0 84px; }
  .setting-control { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .setting-control input[type=range] { flex: 1; accent-color: var(--accent); }
  .setting-control .val { font-size: 13px; color: var(--dim); min-width: 40px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .toggle {
    width: 44px; height: 26px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-radius: 999px;
    position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s;
  }
  .toggle::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px;
    width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff;
    transition: transform 0.18s;
  }
  .toggle.on { background: var(--accent); }
  .toggle.on::after { transform: translateX(18px); }
  #settings-close { width: 100%; padding: 14px; margin-top: 14px; border-radius: 14px; border: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }

  /* Sheet backdrop */
  #sheet-backdrop {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    z-index: 25; display: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s;
  }
  #sheet-backdrop.show { display: block; opacity: 1; }

  /* ================ PREVIEW SCREEN ================ */
  #preview { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: #000; display: none; flex-direction: column; }
  #preview.show { display: flex; }
  #playback { flex: 1; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #000; object-fit: contain; }
  .preview-actions {
    position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    padding: 14px 16px calc(max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) + var(--badge-clearance));
    background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.92) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 65%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%);
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px;
  }
  .btn-ghost { padding: 14px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
  .share-status { position: absolute; top: max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-top)); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75); padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; z-index: 7; backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px); }
  .share-status.ok { color: #34c759; }
  .share-status.err { color: var(--red); }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============ START ============ -->
<div id="start">
  <div class="brand"><svg class="pika-mark" viewBox="0 0 3000 2097.8" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M82.6,2097.9h1083.3c-17.5-175.1-143.1-367-450.2-497.8v-12.9c357.9,109.5,486.6,296.5,539.1,510.6h1336.4 l-215-183.3c125.7-393.4,623.8-579.4,623.8-579.4c-17.6-315.6-180.1-609.8-723.5-848.1L1040.7,0c41.5,519.1,226.5,816.8,690.4,889.8 v12.7c-322.3-7.9-546-151.1-659.5-445.7v-0.1C87.2,636.4-150.1,1385.8,82.6,2097.9z"/></svg> <b>PIKA</b> · TELEPROMPTER</div>
  <h1 id="start-title">Ready when you are.</h1>
  <div class="meta-chips" id="meta"></div>
  <div id="script-preview">Loading…</div>
  <div class="qr-section hidden" id="qr-section">
    <div class="qr-info">
      <div class="qr-label">📱 OPEN ON PHONE</div>
      <div class="qr-title">Scan to record on mobile</div>
      <div class="qr-tip">Same script, just better camera and a more comfortable framing.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="qr-canvas" id="qr-canvas"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="start-bottom">
    <div class="start-tip">The line you're reading will sit right under your camera lens — look there, not down.</div>
    <button class="btn-primary" id="start-btn">Start camera</button>
    <div class="err" id="start-err" hidden></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ RECORD STAGE ============ -->
<div id="stage" hidden>
  <video id="camera" autoplay muted playsinline></video>

  <div id="lens"><span class="dot"></span> camera</div>

  <div id="prompter-window">
    <div id="prompter"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="readzone"></div>

  <div class="corner tl">
    <button class="icon-btn" id="close-btn" title="Back">✕</button>
  </div>
  <div class="corner tr">
    <button class="icon-btn on" id="mirror-btn" title="Mirror">⇋</button>
  </div>

  <div id="countdown"><div class="num">3</div></div>

  <div id="controls">
    <div id="rec-indicator"><span class="dot"></span><span id="rec-time">00:00</span></div>
    <div class="live-sliders">
      <div class="live-slider">
        <label>SPEED</label>
        <input type="range" id="speed-range" min="60" max="240" value="140" step="5" aria-label="Speed">
        <span class="val"><span id="speed-val">140</span></span>
      </div>
      <div class="live-slider">
        <label>SIZE</label>
        <input type="range" id="size-range" min="22" max="46" value="30" step="1" aria-label="Size">
        <span class="val"><span id="size-val">30</span></span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="control-row">
      <button id="reshoot" title="Re-shoot">⟲</button>
      <button id="rec-btn" data-rec="false" title="Record"><span class="core"></span></button>
      <button id="settings-btn" title="Settings">⚙</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="sheet-backdrop"></div>
  <div id="settings-sheet">
    <div class="handle"></div>
    <div class="sheet-title">Settings</div>
    <div class="setting">
      <div class="setting-label">Mirror</div>
      <div class="setting-control"><div class="toggle on" id="mirror-toggle"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="setting">
      <div class="setting-label">Manual</div>
      <div class="setting-control"><div class="toggle" id="manual-toggle"></div></div>
    </div>
    <button id="settings-close">Done</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ PREVIEW ============ -->
<div id="preview">
  <video id="playback" controls playsinline></video>
  <div class="share-status" id="share-status" hidden></div>
  <div class="preview-actions" id="preview-actions">
    <button class="btn-ghost" id="reshoot-from-preview">Re-shoot</button>
    <button class="btn-primary" id="share-btn">Share</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  // ============ PARAMS ============
  // Preferred path: /r?t=... fetches script + upload_url + aspect_ratio from MCP.
  // Legacy/local fallback: plain URL params carry script metadata and #upload carries upload_url.
  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const hashParams = new URLSearchParams(location.hash ? location.hash.replace(/^#/, '') : '');
  const pick = (key, fallback) => {
    const v = params.get(key);
    if (v !== null && v !== '') return v;
    return fallback;
  };
  const pickSecret = (key, fallback) => {
    const v = hashParams.get(key);
    if (v !== null && v !== '') return v;
    return fallback;
  };
  const ALLOWED_MCP_ORIGINS = new Set([
    'https://mcp.pika.me',
    'https://staging-mcp.pika.bot',
    'http://localhost:3000',
    'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
  ]);
  const DEFAULT_MCP_ORIGIN = 'https://mcp.pika.me';
  function safeMcpOrigin(raw) {
    const candidate = raw || DEFAULT_MCP_ORIGIN;
    try {
      const url = new URL(candidate);
      const origin = url.origin;
      return ALLOWED_MCP_ORIGINS.has(origin) ? origin : DEFAULT_MCP_ORIGIN;
    } catch (e) {
      return DEFAULT_MCP_ORIGIN;
    }
  }
  function safeUploadUrl(raw) {
    if (!raw) return '';
    try {
      const url = new URL(raw);
      if (!ALLOWED_MCP_ORIGINS.has(url.origin)) return '';
      if (!/^\/api\/upload-return\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,128}$/.test(url.pathname)) return '';
      url.hash = '';
      return url.toString();
    } catch (e) {
      return '';
    }
  }
  function safeCompleteUrl(raw, uploadOrigin) {
    if (!raw) return '';
    try {
      const url = new URL(raw);
      if (url.origin !== uploadOrigin) return '';
      if (!/^\/api\/upload-return\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,128}\/complete$/.test(url.pathname)) return '';
      url.hash = '';
      return url.toString();
    } catch (e) {
      return '';
    }
  }
  let script = (pick('script', pick('s', "Welcome to the Pika teleprompter.\n\nReplace this default text with your actual script.\n\nThe line you are reading sits at the top — look up there, right under the camera lens."))).trim();
  let handle = pick('handle', '');
  let trend = pick('trend', '');
  let format = pick('format', '');
  let sessionId = pick('session', (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : String(Date.now())));
  let uploadUrl = safeUploadUrl(pickSecret('upload', ''));
  const DEFAULT_ASPECT_RATIO = '9:16';
  const ASPECT_RATIO_PRESETS = {
    '9:16': { width: 1080, height: 1920, label: '9:16 vertical' },
    '16:9': { width: 1920, height: 1080, label: '16:9 landscape' },
    '1:1': { width: 1080, height: 1080, label: '1:1 square' },
    '4:5': { width: 1080, height: 1350, label: '4:5 portrait' }
  };
  const RECORD_FPS = 30;
  function normalizeAspectRatio(value) {
    return ASPECT_RATIO_PRESETS[value] ? value : DEFAULT_ASPECT_RATIO;
  }
  let aspectRatio = normalizeAspectRatio(pick('aspect_ratio', pick('aspect', DEFAULT_ASPECT_RATIO)));
  function recordPreset() {
    return ASPECT_RATIO_PRESETS[aspectRatio] || ASPECT_RATIO_PRESETS[DEFAULT_ASPECT_RATIO];
  }

  // ============ STATE ============
  const $ = sel => document.querySelector(sel);
  const startEl = $('#start');
  const stageEl = $('#stage');
  const previewEl = $('#preview');
  const cameraEl = $('#camera');
  const prompterEl = $('#prompter');
  const prompterWin = $('#prompter-window');
  const readzoneEl = $('#readzone');
  const recBtn = $('#rec-btn');
  const reshootBtn = $('#reshoot');
  const settingsBtn = $('#settings-btn');
  const settingsSheet = $('#settings-sheet');
  const sheetBackdrop = $('#sheet-backdrop');
  const closeBtn = $('#close-btn');
  const mirrorBtn = $('#mirror-btn');
  const mirrorToggle = $('#mirror-toggle');
  const manualToggle = $('#manual-toggle');
  const speedRange = $('#speed-range');
  const sizeRange = $('#size-range');
  const speedValEl = $('#speed-val');
  const sizeValEl = $('#size-val');
  const recIndicator = $('#rec-indicator');
  const recTimeEl = $('#rec-time');
  const countdownEl = $('#countdown');
  const countdownNum = countdownEl.querySelector('.num');
  const lensEl = $('#lens');
  const playback = $('#playback');
  const shareStatus = $('#share-status');

  let mediaStream = null;
  let mediaRecorder = null;
  let recordedChunks = [];
  let recordedBlob = null;
  let isUploading = false;
  let isRecording = false;
  let isScrolling = false; // prompter only scrolls during recording
  let manualMode = false;
  let mirrored = true;
  let lastFrame = 0;
  let scrollY = 0;
  let wpm = 140;
  let fontPx = 30;
  let recStartTs = 0;
  let recTimerInt = null;
  let lineEls = [];
  // Mirror-recording (canvas-based) state
  let mirrorCanvas = null;
  let mirrorRAF = 0;
  let mirrorStream = null;

  async function loadRemoteHandoff() {
    const token = params.get('t');
    if (!token) return;
    const mcpOrigin = safeMcpOrigin(params.get('mcp'));
    const endpoint = mcpOrigin + '/api/teleprompter-handoff?t=' + encodeURIComponent(token);
    const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
      cache: 'no-store'
    });
    let data = {};
    try { data = await res.json(); } catch (e) {}
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(data.message || data.error || ('HTTP ' + res.status));
    }
    if (typeof data.script !== 'string' || !data.script.trim()) {
      throw new Error('Handoff response missing script');
    }
    script = data.script.trim();
    handle = typeof data.handle === 'string' ? data.handle : '';
    trend = typeof data.trend === 'string' ? data.trend : '';
    format = typeof data.format === 'string' ? data.format : '';
    aspectRatio = normalizeAspectRatio(typeof data.aspect_ratio === 'string' ? data.aspect_ratio : '');
    uploadUrl = safeUploadUrl(typeof data.upload_url === 'string' ? data.upload_url : '');
    sessionId = token.slice(0, 12);
    if (!uploadUrl) throw new Error('Handoff response missing safe upload_url');
  }

  // ============ INIT START SCREEN ============
  function initStart() {
    const titleParts = [];
    if (handle) titleParts.push('@' + handle.replace(/^@/, ''));
    if (trend) titleParts.push(trend);
    if (titleParts.length) $('#start-title').textContent = titleParts.join(' · ');
    const metaEl = $('#meta');
    while (metaEl.firstChild) metaEl.removeChild(metaEl.firstChild);
    if (format) {
      const pill = document.createElement('span');
      pill.className = 'chip';
      pill.append('Format: ');
      const b = document.createElement('b');
      b.textContent = format;
      pill.appendChild(b);
      metaEl.appendChild(pill);
    }
    if (handle) {
      const pill = document.createElement('span');
      pill.className = 'chip';
      pill.textContent = '@' + handle.replace(/^@/, '');
      metaEl.appendChild(pill);
    }
    const aspectPill = document.createElement('span');
    aspectPill.className = 'chip';
    aspectPill.append('Record: ');
    const aspectText = document.createElement('b');
    aspectText.textContent = recordPreset().label;
    aspectPill.appendChild(aspectText);
    metaEl.appendChild(aspectPill);
    $('#script-preview').textContent = script;
    refreshShareActionLabel();
  }

  // ============ CAMERA ============
  async function startCamera() {
    try {
      const preset = recordPreset();
      const constraints = {
        video: {
          facingMode: 'user',
          width: { ideal: preset.width },
          height: { ideal: preset.height },
          aspectRatio: { ideal: preset.width / preset.height }
        },
        audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, sampleRate: 48000 }
      };
      mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints);
      cameraEl.srcObject = mediaStream;
      cameraEl.classList.toggle('mirror', mirrored);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      const err = $('#start-err');
      err.textContent = 'Camera access failed: ' + (e.message || e.name || 'unknown') + '. Make sure this page is loaded over HTTPS (or localhost) and tap Start in response to a tap.';
      err.hidden = false;
      return false;
    }
  }

  // ============ PROMPTER ============
  function renderPrompter() {
    const rawLines = script.split(/\n+/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const lines = [];
    // Split every line on natural pauses — . , ! ? — and em-dashes — so each beat is its own chunk.
    // Then merge orphans (< 8 chars OR a leading conjunction/article on its own) into the previous chunk.
    // Finally, force-break any chunk that's still too long at the most natural break word.
    const ORPHAN_WORDS = new Set(['and','or','but','so','because','if','when','that','which','a','an','the','to','of','in','on','at']);
    const BREAK_WORDS = new Set(['and','or','but','so','because','that','which','when','if','to','for','with','of','in','on','at','by','as','from','per','about','into','over','under','than']);
    const MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE = 7;

    function splitLong(s) {
      const words = s.split(/\s+/);
      if (words.length <= MAX_WORDS_PER_LINE) return [s];
      // Find the best break point in the middle 60% of the chunk, preferring BREAK_WORDS, falling back to the midpoint.
      const lo = Math.max(1, Math.floor(words.length * 0.35));
      const hi = Math.min(words.length - 1, Math.ceil(words.length * 0.7));
      let breakIdx = -1;
      for (let i = lo; i <= hi; i++) {
        const w = words[i].toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '');
        if (BREAK_WORDS.has(w)) {
          // Prefer the one nearest the center
          if (breakIdx === -1 || Math.abs(i - words.length / 2) < Math.abs(breakIdx - words.length / 2)) breakIdx = i;
        }
      }
      if (breakIdx < 1) breakIdx = Math.floor(words.length / 2);
      const left = words.slice(0, breakIdx).join(' ');
      const right = words.slice(breakIdx).join(' ');
      return [...splitLong(left), ...splitLong(right)];
    }

    for (const ln of rawLines) {
      const parts = ln.split(/(?<=[.!?,—])\s+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      for (const p of parts) {
        const subChunks = splitLong(p);
        for (const chunk of subChunks) {
          if (!lines.length) { lines.push(chunk); continue; }
          const first = chunk.split(/\s+/)[0].toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '');
          const isOrphan = chunk.length < 8 || (chunk.length < 18 && ORPHAN_WORDS.has(first));
          if (isOrphan) {
            lines[lines.length - 1] = lines[lines.length - 1] + ' ' + chunk;
          } else {
            lines.push(chunk);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    while (prompterEl.firstChild) prompterEl.removeChild(prompterEl.firstChild);
    for (const ln of lines) {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'line';
      div.textContent = ln;
      prompterEl.appendChild(div);
    }
    lineEls = Array.from(prompterEl.querySelectorAll('.line'));
    refreshWordCounts();
    applyFontSize();
    positionReadZone();
    // Initial state: first line sits right ON the read zone so the user can see what they'll start with.
    // We compute the offset needed to align line 0's center with the read zone target.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      anchorFirstLine();
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    });
  }

  function anchorFirstLine() {
    if (!lineEls.length) return;
    const targetY = readZoneTargetY();
    const first = lineEls[0].getBoundingClientRect();
    const firstCenter = first.top + first.height / 2;
    // Lead-in: park the first line ~1.5 line heights BELOW the read zone so when scrolling
    // starts, it travels visibly upward into position before the user has to speak it.
    // (Without this, line 1 is on the read zone the instant REC fires — too sudden to track.)
    const lineH = fontPx * 1.28 + fontPx * 0.45;
    const leadInOffset = lineH * 1.5;
    scrollY += (firstCenter - targetY) - leadInOffset;
    applyTransform();
  }

  function readZoneTargetY() {
    const wr = prompterWin.getBoundingClientRect();
    return wr.top + Math.max(40, wr.height * 0.18); // 18% from top of prompter window
  }

  function positionReadZone() {
    const y = readZoneTargetY();
    readzoneEl.style.top = y + 'px';
  }

  function applyFontSize() {
    prompterEl.style.fontSize = fontPx + 'px';
  }

  function applyTransform() {
    prompterEl.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (-scrollY) + 'px)';
  }

  // Pixels-per-second is computed PER LINE based on actual word count, so a 1-word line
  // gets time to breathe and a 20-word line scrolls past at the right pace.
  // Velocity at any moment = (distance to next line's center) / (dwell time of the active line).
  let _wordCounts = []; // cached per-line word counts
  function pixelsPerSecond() {
    if (!lineEls.length) return 30;
    const targetY = readZoneTargetY();
    // Find the active line — the one closest to the read zone.
    let activeIdx = 0, bestDist = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < lineEls.length; i++) {
      const r = lineEls[i].getBoundingClientRect();
      const center = r.top + r.height / 2;
      const d = Math.abs(center - targetY);
      if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; activeIdx = i; }
    }
    if (activeIdx >= lineEls.length - 1) return 18; // last line — slow drift
    const wordsHere = _wordCounts[activeIdx] || 1;
    // Dwell time = how long the speaker should spend on this line, derived from wpm.
    // Floor at 0.55s so short interjections (e.g. "Cents.") aren't blink-and-miss.
    const dwellSec = Math.max(0.55, wordsHere / (wpm / 60));
    const curR = lineEls[activeIdx].getBoundingClientRect();
    const nxtR = lineEls[activeIdx + 1].getBoundingClientRect();
    const distance = (nxtR.top + nxtR.height / 2) - (curR.top + curR.height / 2);
    return distance / dwellSec;
  }

  function refreshWordCounts() {
    _wordCounts = lineEls.map(el => el.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length);
  }

  function loop(ts) {
    if (!lastFrame) lastFrame = ts;
    const dt = Math.min(0.08, (ts - lastFrame) / 1000);
    lastFrame = ts;
    if (isScrolling && !manualMode) {
      scrollY += pixelsPerSecond() * dt;
      applyTransform();
    }
    const targetY = readZoneTargetY();
    for (const el of lineEls) {
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const center = r.top + r.height / 2;
      const dist = Math.abs(center - targetY);
      const prox = Math.max(0, 1 - dist / 180);
      const above = center < targetY - 8;
      const opacity = above ? Math.max(0.12, prox * 0.55) : Math.max(0.34, 0.34 + prox * 0.66);
      const scale = 0.82 + prox * 0.42;
      el.style.opacity = opacity.toFixed(3);
      el.style.transform = 'scale(' + scale.toFixed(3) + ')';
      el.style.transformOrigin = 'center top';
      el.style.color = prox > 0.55 ? '#fff' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  function tapAdvance() {
    if (!lineEls.length) return;
    const targetY = readZoneTargetY();
    let currentIdx = 0, bestDist = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < lineEls.length; i++) {
      const r = lineEls[i].getBoundingClientRect();
      const center = r.top + r.height / 2;
      const d = Math.abs(center - targetY);
      if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; currentIdx = i; }
    }
    const nextIdx = Math.min(lineEls.length - 1, currentIdx + 1);
    if (nextIdx === currentIdx) return;
    const cur = lineEls[currentIdx].getBoundingClientRect();
    const nxt = lineEls[nextIdx].getBoundingClientRect();
    scrollY += (nxt.top + nxt.height / 2) - (cur.top + cur.height / 2);
    applyTransform();
  }

  // ============ RECORDING ============
  function pickMime() {
    const cands = [
      'video/mp4;codecs=h264,aac',
      'video/mp4',
      'video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus',
      'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus',
      'video/webm'
    ];
    for (const c of cands) {
      if (typeof MediaRecorder !== 'undefined' && MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(c)) return c;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function wait(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }

  async function runCountdown() {
    countdownEl.classList.add('show');
    for (let i = 3; i >= 1; i--) {
      countdownNum.textContent = String(i);
      // re-trigger the pop animation
      countdownNum.style.animation = 'none';
      countdownNum.offsetHeight;
      countdownNum.style.animation = '';
      await wait(900);
    }
    countdownEl.classList.remove('show');
  }

  function drawVideoCover(ctx, video, canvasW, canvasH, shouldMirror) {
    const sourceW = video.videoWidth || canvasW;
    const sourceH = video.videoHeight || canvasH;
    const sourceRatio = sourceW / sourceH;
    const targetRatio = canvasW / canvasH;
    let sx = 0;
    let sy = 0;
    let sw = sourceW;
    let sh = sourceH;

    if (sourceRatio > targetRatio) {
      sw = sourceH * targetRatio;
      sx = (sourceW - sw) / 2;
    } else {
      sh = sourceW / targetRatio;
      sy = (sourceH - sh) / 2;
    }

    ctx.save();
    if (shouldMirror) {
      ctx.translate(canvasW, 0);
      ctx.scale(-1, 1);
    }
    ctx.drawImage(video, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Build the stream we actually record. Route video through the requested target-aspect canvas.
  // Audio track is passed through directly from the mic.
  function buildRecordStream() {
    const videoTrack = mediaStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
    if (!videoTrack) return mediaStream;
    mirrorCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    if (!mirrorCanvas.captureStream) return mediaStream;
    const preset = recordPreset();
    mirrorCanvas.width = preset.width;
    mirrorCanvas.height = preset.height;
    const ctx = mirrorCanvas.getContext('2d');
    let active = true;
    function tick() {
      if (!active) return;
      if (cameraEl.readyState >= 2) {
        drawVideoCover(ctx, cameraEl, preset.width, preset.height, mirrored);
      }
      mirrorRAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    mirrorRAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    mirrorCanvas.__stop = () => { active = false; };
    const canvasStream = mirrorCanvas.captureStream(RECORD_FPS);
    mirrorStream = new MediaStream([
      ...canvasStream.getVideoTracks(),
      ...mediaStream.getAudioTracks()
    ]);
    return mirrorStream;
  }

  function teardownMirrorStream() {
    if (mirrorRAF) { cancelAnimationFrame(mirrorRAF); mirrorRAF = 0; }
    if (mirrorCanvas && mirrorCanvas.__stop) mirrorCanvas.__stop();
    mirrorCanvas = null;
    if (mirrorStream) {
      try { mirrorStream.getTracks().forEach(t => { if (t.kind === 'video') t.stop(); }); } catch (e) {}
      mirrorStream = null;
    }
  }

  async function startRecording() {
    if (isRecording || !mediaStream) return;
    // Reset prompter to first line
    anchorFirstLine();
    isScrolling = false;
    await runCountdown();
    recordedChunks = [];
    const mime = pickMime();
    const streamToRecord = buildRecordStream();
    try {
      mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(streamToRecord, mime ? { mimeType: mime } : undefined);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('MediaRecorder unavailable: ' + e.message);
      teardownMirrorStream();
      return;
    }
    mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = e => { if (e.data && e.data.size) recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
    mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
      const type = mime || (recordedChunks[0] && recordedChunks[0].type) || 'video/webm';
      recordedBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type });
      showPreview();
    };
    mediaRecorder.start(250);
    isRecording = true;
    isScrolling = true;
    recBtn.dataset.rec = 'true';
    recIndicator.classList.add('show');
    lensEl.style.opacity = '0';
    recStartTs = performance.now();
    recTimeEl.textContent = '00:00';
    recTimerInt = setInterval(() => {
      const s = Math.floor((performance.now() - recStartTs) / 1000);
      recTimeEl.textContent = String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(s%60).padStart(2,'0');
    }, 250);
  }

  function stopRecording() {
    if (!isRecording) return;
    isRecording = false;
    isScrolling = false;
    recBtn.dataset.rec = 'false';
    recIndicator.classList.remove('show');
    lensEl.style.opacity = '';
    clearInterval(recTimerInt);
    try { mediaRecorder.stop(); } catch (e) {}
    // Stop the canvas mirror pipeline after the recorder fully flushes (onstop)
    setTimeout(teardownMirrorStream, 250);
  }

  // ============ PREVIEW & SHARE ============
  function showPreview() {
    if (!recordedBlob) return;
    playback.src = URL.createObjectURL(recordedBlob);
    stageEl.hidden = true;
    previewEl.classList.add('show');
  }

  function backToRecord() {
    previewEl.classList.remove('show');
    stageEl.hidden = false;
    if (playback.src) { URL.revokeObjectURL(playback.src); playback.src = ''; }
    recordedBlob = null;
    anchorFirstLine();
    isScrolling = false;
    shareStatus.hidden = true;
  }

  // Pre-detect if the browser supports navigator.share with files — used to decide whether
  // the Share button opens the native share sheet (iOS AirDrop / Save Video / etc.) or
  // falls back to a download. Web Share API for files: iOS Safari 14+, Android Chrome.
  function canNativeShareFiles() {
    if (!navigator.share || !navigator.canShare) return false;
    try {
      const probe = new File(['x'], 'probe.mp4', { type: 'video/mp4' });
      return navigator.canShare({ files: [probe] });
    } catch (e) { return false; }
  }

  async function shareRecording() {
    if (!recordedBlob) return;
    const ext = extFor(recordedBlob.type);
    const fileName = 'pika-take-' + sessionId.slice(0, 8) + '.' + ext;
    const file = new File([recordedBlob], fileName, { type: recordedBlob.type, lastModified: Date.now() });

    if (canNativeShareFiles()) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Pika Teleprompter take' });
        shareStatus.hidden = false;
        shareStatus.className = 'share-status ok';
        shareStatus.textContent = '✓ Shared.';
      } catch (e) {
        // AbortError = user cancelled the share sheet — silent
        if (e.name === 'AbortError') return;
        shareStatus.hidden = false;
        shareStatus.className = 'share-status err';
        shareStatus.textContent = 'Share failed: ' + (e.message || e.name);
      }
    } else {
      // Desktop / unsupported browser → download
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(recordedBlob);
      a.download = fileName;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      shareStatus.hidden = false;
      shareStatus.className = 'share-status ok';
      shareStatus.textContent = '✓ Saved to downloads.';
    }
  }

  async function uploadRecording() {
    if (!uploadUrl || !recordedBlob || isUploading) return false;
    isUploading = true;
    const shareBtn = $('#share-btn');
    const previousLabel = shareBtn.textContent;
    shareBtn.disabled = true;
    shareBtn.textContent = 'Uploading…';
    shareStatus.hidden = false;
    shareStatus.className = 'share-status';
    shareStatus.textContent = 'Uploading take…';
    try {
      const uploadOrigin = new URL(uploadUrl).origin;
      const startRes = await fetch(uploadUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          mime_type: recordedBlob.type || 'video/webm',
          size_bytes: recordedBlob.size
        })
      });
      let startData = {};
      try { startData = await startRes.json(); } catch (e) {}
      if (!startRes.ok) {
        throw new Error(startData.message || startData.error || ('HTTP ' + startRes.status));
      }
      if (startData.uploaded && startData.public_url) {
        shareStatus.className = 'share-status ok';
        shareStatus.textContent = '✓ Uploaded. Return to chat.';
        shareBtn.textContent = 'Uploaded';
        return true;
      }
      if (String(startData.direct_upload_method || 'PUT').toUpperCase() !== 'PUT') {
        throw new Error('Unexpected direct upload method');
      }
      if (String(startData.complete_method || 'POST').toUpperCase() !== 'POST') {
        throw new Error('Unexpected completion method');
      }
      if (!startData.direct_upload_url || !startData.attempt_id) {
        throw new Error('Upload start response missing direct_upload_url or attempt_id');
      }
      const completeUrl = safeCompleteUrl(startData.complete_url, uploadOrigin);
      if (!completeUrl) {
        throw new Error('Upload start response missing safe complete_url');
      }
      const directHeaders = {};
      const returnedHeaders = startData.direct_upload_headers;
      if (returnedHeaders && typeof returnedHeaders === 'object') {
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(returnedHeaders)) {
          if (typeof v === 'string') directHeaders[k] = v;
        }
      }
      if (!directHeaders['Content-Type']) {
        directHeaders['Content-Type'] = recordedBlob.type || 'video/webm';
      }
      const putRes = await fetch(startData.direct_upload_url, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: directHeaders,
        body: recordedBlob
      });
      if (!putRes.ok) {
        throw new Error('Direct upload failed with HTTP ' + putRes.status);
      }
      const completeRes = await fetch(completeUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ attempt_id: startData.attempt_id })
      });
      let completeData = {};
      try { completeData = await completeRes.json(); } catch (e) {}
      if (!completeRes.ok) {
        throw new Error(completeData.message || completeData.error || ('HTTP ' + completeRes.status));
      }
      shareStatus.className = 'share-status ok';
      shareStatus.textContent = completeData.public_url ? '✓ Uploaded. Return to chat.' : '✓ Uploaded.';
      shareBtn.textContent = 'Uploaded';
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      shareStatus.className = 'share-status err';
      shareStatus.textContent = 'Upload failed: ' + (e.message || e.name || 'unknown') + '. Opening Share/Save fallback.';
      shareBtn.textContent = previousLabel;
      return false;
    } finally {
      isUploading = false;
      shareBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  async function uploadOrShareRecording() {
    if (uploadUrl) {
      const uploaded = await uploadRecording();
      if (uploaded) return;
    }
    await shareRecording();
  }

  if (window.__PIKA_TELEPROMPTER_E2E__) {
    window.__pikaTeleprompterE2E = {
      get uploadUrl() { return uploadUrl; },
      get aspectRatio() { return aspectRatio; },
      recordPreset,
      setRecordedBlobForTest(blob) { recordedBlob = blob; },
      uploadRecording
    };
  }

  function extFor(mime) {
    if (!mime) return 'webm';
    if (mime.includes('mp4')) return 'mp4';
    return 'webm';
  }

  // ============ SETTINGS SHEET ============
  function openSheet() { settingsSheet.classList.add('open'); sheetBackdrop.classList.add('show'); }
  function closeSheet() { settingsSheet.classList.remove('open'); sheetBackdrop.classList.remove('show'); }

  // ============ EVENT WIRING ============
  $('#start-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const ok = await startCamera();
    if (!ok) return;
    startEl.hidden = true;
    stageEl.hidden = false;
    renderPrompter();
  });

  recBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { if (isRecording) stopRecording(); else startRecording(); });
  reshootBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (isRecording) stopRecording();
    recordedBlob = null; recordedChunks = [];
    anchorFirstLine();
    isScrolling = false;
  });
  settingsBtn.addEventListener('click', openSheet);
  sheetBackdrop.addEventListener('click', closeSheet);
  $('#settings-close').addEventListener('click', closeSheet);

  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (isRecording) stopRecording();
    if (confirm('Close the teleprompter? Any unsaved take will be lost.')) {
      stageEl.hidden = true;
      startEl.hidden = false;
    }
  });

  function setMirror(on) {
    mirrored = on;
    cameraEl.classList.toggle('mirror', mirrored);
    mirrorBtn.classList.toggle('on', mirrored);
    mirrorToggle.classList.toggle('on', mirrored);
  }
  mirrorBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setMirror(!mirrored));
  mirrorToggle.addEventListener('click', () => setMirror(!mirrored));

  manualToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    manualMode = !manualMode;
    manualToggle.classList.toggle('on', manualMode);
  });

  speedRange.addEventListener('input', () => { wpm = parseInt(speedRange.value, 10); speedValEl.textContent = String(wpm); });
  sizeRange.addEventListener('input', () => {
    fontPx = parseInt(sizeRange.value, 10);
    sizeValEl.textContent = String(fontPx);
    applyFontSize();
    positionReadZone();
    // re-anchor so adjusting size doesn't visually jump the active line off-zone
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (!isRecording) anchorFirstLine(); });
  });

  // Tap on prompter area = advance one line (in manual mode), or pause/resume scroll (normal)
  prompterWin.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    // only react when stage visible
    if (stageEl.hidden) return;
    if (manualMode) {
      tapAdvance();
    } else if (isRecording) {
      isScrolling = !isScrolling;
    }
  });

  $('#reshoot-from-preview').addEventListener('click', backToRecord);

# Content Director — Teleprompter (browser camera + prompter add-on)

## What this does

The `formats/talking.md` and `formats/duet.md` playbooks both reach a point where
they hand the user a script and say *"now film it."* That hand-off used to be a dead-end — the
user had to copy the script into a phone teleprompter app, set up framing, fight with prompter
speed, and remember to send the result back.

The handoff replaces that step with a one-tap short link. The agent calls
`create_teleprompter_handoff` and sends the returned URL:

```
https://teleprompter.pika.bot/r?t=...
```

The user taps it → camera + prompter come up → they hit record → re-shoot → **Upload**.
The page uses the token to fetch `script`, `upload_url`, and `aspect_ratio` from MCP. It POSTs
`{mime_type,size_bytes}` to that browser-safe `upload_url`. The start response returns
`direct_upload_url`, `direct_upload_headers`, `attempt_id`, and `complete_url`; the page PUTs the
recorded Blob directly to the CDN URL, then POSTs the `attempt_id` to `complete_url`. The agent
polls the returned `status_url` until it sees `public_url`, then resumes its pipeline (captions,
edit, etc.). If upload fails, the page falls back to Share/Save so the user can still send the take
manually.

### Upload-return flow

The canonical playbook handoff uses `create_teleprompter_handoff`. **Do NOT pass raw `upload_asset` presigned URLs** to the browser:
short-lived presigned URLs can expire during a realistic recording session (open link → adjust
speed → 2-3 takes → preview → upload), and they put a storage bearer URL in front of the user before
the user is ready to upload.

So for this flow: call `create_teleprompter_handoff`, emit its short `teleprompter_url`, and keep
its `status_url` in agent state only. The MCP handoff row stores the script, `upload_url`, and
`aspect_ratio`; the browser fetches those through `/api/teleprompter-handoff?t=...`. Do not pass the
agent-pollable `status_url` to the browser. The page sends a JSON start request to `upload_url`,
receives `direct_upload_url`, `direct_upload_headers`, `attempt_id`, and `complete_url`, PUTs the
Blob to the CDN URL, then completes the session by POSTing `{attempt_id}`. The MCP upload-return
endpoint mints the short-lived CDN presign only when upload starts, so recording time no longer
races the presign TTL.

### Used by

- ✅ `formats/talking.md` (Stage 4f) — script is the spoken delivery to camera
- ✅ `formats/duet.md` (Stage 4f) — script is the user's reaction half of the stitch/duet
- ❌ `formats/pov.md` — silent acting, deliverable is on-screen captions + shot list
- ❌ `formats/dance.md` — AI-generated dance from a photo, no live filming

## The short-token contract

`create_teleprompter_handoff` returns:

| Field | Who uses it | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `teleprompter_url` | User/browser | Short URL, normally `https://teleprompter.pika.bot/r?t=...`. This is what the agent surfaces to the user and QR generator. |
| `qr_image_url` | User/agent | Browser-viewable SVG QR image for the same `teleprompter_url`. Render this in chat so desktop users can scan with a phone. |
| `status_url` | Agent only | Poll until it returns `status="uploaded"` with `public_url`. Never show this URL to the browser. |
| `aspect_ratio` | Agent + browser | Recording ratio used by the page and shown to the user. Supported: `9:16`, `16:9`, `1:1`, `4:5`. Default: `9:16`. |
| `expires_at` | Agent | User-facing expiry if needed. |

The browser then reads `/api/teleprompter-handoff?t=...`, which returns only browser-safe state:
`script`, optional `handle`/`trend`/`format`, `aspect_ratio`, `upload_url`, and expiry. It does not
return `status_url`.

Legacy/manual fallback: the page still accepts `script`/`s`, `handle`, `trend`, `format`,
`aspect_ratio`/`aspect`, and `#upload=...` for local testing. Production playbooks should use the
short-token MCP tool so QR codes stay sparse.

## Wiring into the playbooks

In `formats/talking.md` or `formats/duet.md` Stage 4f (or wherever the script is finalized), add a
step:

1. Create the teleprompter handoff:
   ```python
   handoff = create_teleprompter_handoff(
       script=state.script_text,
       handle=state.handle,
       trend=state.pick.name,
       format=state.format,              # "talking" or "duet"
       aspect_ratio=getattr(state, "recording_aspect_ratio", "9:16"),
       filename=f"{state.handle.lstrip('@')}-{state.format}-take.webm",
       mime_type="video/webm",          # preferred; endpoint accepts browser mp4/webm variants in the same family
       max_size_bytes=350_000_000,      # enough for a short 9:16 phone take
       expires_in_s=86400,
   )
   state.teleprompter_url = handoff["teleprompter_url"]
   state.teleprompter_qr_image_url = handoff["qr_image_url"]
   state.teleprompter_status_url = handoff["status_url"]
   state.teleprompter_aspect_ratio = handoff["aspect_ratio"]
   ```
2. **Emit `state.teleprompter_url` and `state.teleprompter_qr_image_url`** to the chat — see the next section.
3. Tell the user to record, hit **Upload**, and return to chat. If upload fails, the page opens the Share/Save fallback.
4. Poll `state.teleprompter_status_url` until it returns `status="uploaded"` with `public_url`, then resume the pipeline with that uploaded take.

The page itself is stateless — no DB, no auth, no analytics. The temporary handoff state lives in
the MCP jobs registry behind the short token.

## The handoff — URL + returned QR image (canonical pattern)

Every time the agent hands off the link, show both values returned by
`create_teleprompter_handoff`:

1. **The clickable URL** — for desktop users who want to record at their workstation, or who'd
   rather paste the link into their phone manually.
2. **The `qr_image_url` SVG** — for desktop users who want to record on their phone.
   Scanning it opens the same URL with the same script preloaded. No copy-paste, no typing, and
   no local Python package dependency.

Do not invent a local helper name and do not hard-code an unapproved third-party service in the
skill:

```python
qr_image_url = state.teleprompter_qr_image_url
```

Then render it in the handoff message:

```markdown
![Scan QR]({qr_image_url})
```

Caption the QR with the same message as the URL — e.g. *"Film it on your phone — scan or click."*
If the QR image fails to render in a client, keep the clickable URL visible as the fallback.

### URL length budget

QR codes get progressively denser as URLs grow. The short-token URL is normally far below the risky
range, which is why this handoff exists. Practical thresholds:

| URL length | Result |
|---|---|
| **< 600 chars** | Sparse QR, scans instantly even in dim light |
| **600 – 1200** | Dense, still reliable |
| **1200 – 1800** | Very dense — needs a clean phone screen and steady hand. Last reasonable tier. |
| **> 1800** | Skip the QR, surface only the clickable URL with a "tap to open on this device" instruction |

If the URL is going to exceed 1500 chars, something is wrong: do not put the script or upload URL
back into the QR. Use `create_teleprompter_handoff` so the script stays server-side behind the
token.

### Example handoff message

```
🎬 Your script is ready. Film it on your phone:

📱 Scan this QR on your phone (opens teleprompter.pika.bot with the script preloaded):
   ![Scan QR]({qr_image_url})

🔗 Or open directly:
   {state.teleprompter_url}

When you're done, hit Upload. I'll watch the upload status and start the edit as soon as the take lands. If upload fails, use Share/Save and send the MP4 back here.
```

## Hosting

Two clean options:

- **`web_publish`** — push `teleprompter.html` to Pika's static host and use the returned HTTPS
  URL forever. Best for production.
- **`capture_website` (dev only)** — not useful here; this page needs real camera access from the
  user's device.

For local development: `python3 -m http.server 8443 --bind 127.0.0.1` won't work for mobile
testing because mobile browsers refuse camera on non-HTTPS, non-localhost origins. Easiest mobile
dev loop is `web_publish` to a temporary URL.

## What the page does on its own

- Asks for camera + mic on tap (iOS Safari requires a user gesture for `getUserMedia`).
- Renders the script with each line broken on natural pauses (`. , ! ? —`), then force-splits any
  chunk over 7 words at the most natural break-word (and / or / to / per / of / from / etc.) near
  the middle so 20-word run-ons don't survive. Tiny orphan fragments (under 8 chars or a leading
  conjunction/article on its own) get merged back into the previous chunk so you don't get
  "yeah," sitting alone.
- Anchors a glowing **read zone** at the very top of the prompter window — close to the front
  camera. The line crossing that zone grows + brightens; lines that have already passed fade and
  shrink. The user's eye-line stays high.
- **Lead-in:** the first line is parked ~1.5 line heights below the read zone so when scrolling
  starts after the countdown, line 1 travels visibly upward into position — giving the user a
  beat to lock onto it before they have to speak. (Without this it lands on the read zone the
  instant REC fires, which is too sudden to track.)
- **Per-line pacing:** scroll velocity is computed per line as `(distance to next line) ÷
  (this line's word count ÷ wpm × 60)`, floored at 0.55s, so a 1-word zinger like "Cents." gets
  time to breathe and a 10-word sentence scrolls past at the right reading speed. The same WPM
  setting means very different pixel speeds in different parts of the script — by design.
- Picks the best supported MIME (`video/mp4;codecs=h264,aac` first on iOS 17+, falls back to webm
  on Android/desktop).
- Shows the requested recording ratio on the start screen. Default is `9:16` (`1080×1920`), but the
  handoff can request `16:9` (`1920×1080`), `1:1` (`1080×1080`), or `4:5` (`1080×1350`). The page
  records through that target-aspect canvas with cover-crop normalization, so a mismatched physical
  camera stream still uploads the requested take shape.
- Records via `MediaRecorder`, plays back the take, and lets the user re-shoot or upload.
- If the handoff provides `upload_url`, starts the upload-return session with JSON, PUTs the Blob to
  the returned `direct_upload_url`, POSTs `attempt_id` to `complete_url`, and falls back to
  Share/Save if any step fails.

## Controls (built in)

All controls live on the main record screen — nothing important is hidden in a menu.

| Control | What |
|---|---|
| **● REC** | Big red button. Tap → 3-2-1 countdown → recording starts; prompter starts scrolling. Tap again → stop → preview screen. |
| **00:00 timer** | Sits just above the slider row when recording — never overlays the script. |
| **SPEED slider** (60–240 wpm) | Live on the main screen. Adjustable mid-take without opening any menu. |
| **SIZE slider** (22–46 px) | Live on the main screen. Adjustable mid-take. |
| **⟲ Re-shoot** | Discards take, re-parks the first line below the read zone, ready to go again. |
| **Upload / Share / Save** | Preview action. With upload-return it uploads first; without upload-return or after upload failure it uses native Share or download. |
| **Tap the prompter** | Pause / resume scroll during recording. In Manual mode (settings), tapping advances one line. |
| **⇋ Mirror** | Top-right toggle and also in settings — preview only; the recorded video is canonical. |
| **⚙ Settings sheet** | Slides up from the bottom — only contains the two toggles (Mirror, Manual). The sliders are NOT here. |
| **✕** | Top-left bail-out — confirms before discarding. |

## What this playbook is NOT

- Not a backend. No accounts, no recording-history, no streaming. One-page, stateless.
- Not a production switcher. It's a single-person front-camera setup.
- Not a beam-splitter prompter. The read zone is the best compromise — eye-line drift is minimal
  but not zero.

## Triggers (in case the user invokes it directly)

Mostly you'll never trigger this page standalone — the parent playbook calls it. But if the
user says any of:

- "give me a teleprompter for this script"
- "open the camera + prompter"
- "set up the recording page"
- "let me film this in the browser"

…produce a URL with at least `script=` and hand them the link.

# Salesforce Archive

Operate Salesforce Archive (also called Trusted Services Archive) through its Connect API and the `ArchiveActivity` job-metadata object. This skill covers how to search and restore archived records, run the analyzer, handle RTBF erasure and PII masking, check storage, and — the part most often missed — how to read archive job status from `ArchiveActivity` and use a job's Id + Type to download its logs.

## Scope

- **In scope**: Calling the Archive Connect API operations under `/platform/data-resilience/archive/`; querying the `ArchiveActivity` object via SOQL/Connect; correlating a job's `ArchiveActivity` record with its log-download endpoints; the verify-after-write pattern for each async operation.
- **Out of scope**: Defining archive policies / `ArchivePolicyDefinition` metadata; building UI; generating Flows over archive data (`ArchiveActivity` is **not** Flow-queryable — see Gotchas); generic backup/export tooling unrelated to the add-on.

---

## Required Inputs

Gather or infer before acting:

- **Operation intent**: search (this is also how you view archived records), unarchive, analyze, mask, RTBF, storage check, or job-status/log lookup.
- **Target sObject** (`sobjectName`): required for search and unarchive.
- **Filters**: search and unarchive require `sobjectName` + at least one filter.
- **For log downloads**: the `requestId` (an `ArchiveActivity` Id, `8qv…` prefix) of a completed, log-producing job, and `reportType` = that activity's `Type`.

Preconditions (confirm or surface to the user if a call returns a not-permitted error):
- The **org** must have Salesforce Archive enabled. Every operation is gated on this first.
- Each operation requires a **specific user permission** on top of the org gate — see the Permissions table below. There is no single "archive admin" role; access is per-capability.

---

## Permissions

Every operation first requires the org to have Salesforce Archive enabled. On top of that org gate, each capability is gated by a distinct **user permission**. A call the user isn't permitted for fails with a "not permitted" error — match the error to the missing permission below.

| Operation | User permission required |
|-----------|--------------------------|
| `search-archived-records`, `get-search-archived-records-next-page` | `ViewSearchPage` (Archive Search) — **not** `ViewArchivedRecords` |
| `search-archived-records-with-sharing-rules` | `ViewArchivedRecords` |
| `unarchive-records` | `UnarchiveSdk` |
| `forget-archived-records` (RTBF) + `get-rtbf-status` | `Rtbf` |
| `mask-archived-records` + `get-masking-status` | `Rtbf` (masking shares the same `Rtbf` permission — **not** a separate entitlement) |
| `run-analyzer`, `get-analyzer-report`, `get-archive-storage-used` | `ArchiveAnalyzer` |
| `get-execution-details-stream-url`, `get-failed-records-stream-url` | `ViewActivitiesPage` (Archive Activities) |

---

## Workflow

All steps are sequential within a task. Read the referenced file the first time you touch that area.

1. **Identify the operation and read the contract** — do not rely on general knowledge of the Archive API, which has non-obvious contracts. Load `references/connect-api-operations.md` for the exact request/response shape, required inputs, and per-operation gotchas of every Archive Connect API operation. Do this before constructing any call (e.g. `dateRanges` plural vs singular, `isSuccess` flag vs HTTP status, `url: null` meaning no log).

2. **For job status / monitoring, read the data model** — when the task involves archive jobs, failures, progress, counts, or logs, load `references/archive-activity-entity.md` for the `ArchiveActivity` field reference and how it links to the Connect API. Query `ArchiveActivity` via SOQL or Connect — **not** Flow. For a worked end-to-end example (find failed/in-progress jobs, then pull their execution-detail and failed-records logs), load `examples/monitor-failed-jobs.md`.

3. **Construct and send the call** — every operation is a `{method, path, body}` REST call. Send it with whatever Connect/REST API tool your environment provides (an MCP server that invokes Connect/REST APIs, the `sf` CLI, or any REST client). Two path rules are critical (full per-operation contracts are in `references/connect-api-operations.md`):

   - **The operation names in this skill are NOT URL paths.** `search-archived-records`, `unarchive-records`, etc. are labels; never put them in the path. Use the short literal paths below (each relative to base `/platform/data-resilience/archive`). Sending the operation name as a path segment (e.g. `/…/archive/search-archived-records`) returns **404**.
   - **The path stops at `/platform/data-resilience/archive/…` — there is NO `/connect` segment**, even though this is a Connect API. A **404 / `NOT_FOUND` here means the path is wrong, NOT that Archive is disabled** — fix the path before concluding the add-on is missing.

   | Operation | Method + Path | Notes |
   |-----------|---------------|-------|
   | search-archived-records | `POST /search` | requires `sobjectName` + ≥1 filter |
   | search next page | `GET /search/next/{scrollId}` | stop when `scroll_id == "-1"` |
   | search with sharing rules | `POST /search/with-sharing-rules` | uses `filtersJson` object map |
   | unarchive-records | `POST /unarchive` | `sobjectName` + filters |
   | run-analyzer / report | `POST /analyzer/run` · `GET /analyzer/report` | |
   | forget / RTBF + status | `POST /rtbf` · `GET /rtbf/{requestId}` | |
   | mask + status | `POST /mask` · `GET /mask/{requestId}` | |
   | storage used | `GET /storage/archive-used` | |
   | execution-detail / failed-records log | `GET /log/execution-details-stream-url` · `GET /log/failed-records-stream-url` | query params `requestId`, `reportType` |

   With the `sf` CLI, prefix the path with `/services/data/v67.0`; some MCP/REST tools take the bare path and add the version themselves (tool-dependent — see the reference). Then follow the contract: for searches, supply `sobjectName` + ≥1 filter; for date filtering use the plural `dateRanges` array of `{field, from, to}` with full ISO-8601 datetimes.

4. **Branch on the right signal** — some operations return HTTP 201 with a body-level success flag (`body.statusCode`, `body.isSuccess`). Read `references/connect-api-operations.md` for which signal to trust per operation; never assume the HTTP status alone means success.

5. **Verify after every write** — re-read state to confirm the effect (see the Verify-After-Write table below). Async operations (analyzer, RTBF, masking) return a request id you must poll.

---

## Verify-After-Write

| After this write | Confirm by |
|------------------|-----------|
| `run-analyzer` | Poll `get-analyzer-report` until the report is populated |
| `unarchive-records` | Re-run `search-archived-records` — confirm records left the archive |
| `forget-archived-records` (RTBF) | Poll `get-rtbf-status` with the returned `request_id` |
| `mask-archived-records` | Poll `get-masking-status` with the returned `request_id` |

---

## Rules / Constraints

| Constraint | Rationale |
|-----------|-----------|
| Search & unarchive require `sobjectName` + at least one filter | An unfiltered request is rejected with "Search must be based on at least 1 field" — a full-object operation is never allowed. |
| Date filters must be full ISO-8601 datetimes (`2020-01-01T00:00:00Z`) | A date-only value (`2020-01-01`) returns `400 JSON_PARSER_ERROR` because the field is typed `xsd:dateTime`. |
| Search uses `dateRanges` (plural array); unarchive uses `dateRange` (singular) | They are genuinely different fields on the two endpoints; using the wrong shape silently drops the filter or 400s. |
| Stop pagination when `scroll_id == "-1"` | Calling `get-search-archived-records-next-page` with `"-1"` returns 500. |
| Log downloads need a real `ArchiveActivity` Id as `requestId` + that activity's `Type` as `reportType` | The backend resolves the log by the activity record; a mismatched `reportType` returns no log. |
| Excluded objects are not retrievable | `Feed`, `History`, `Relation`, `Share` are not searchable; Files/Attachments are not retrievable via this API — do not promise them. |
| Query `ArchiveActivity` via SOQL/Connect, never Flow | `ArchiveActivity` has `isProcessEnabled=false`, so a Flow "Get Records" element on it fails with "You can't get ArchiveActivity records in a flow." |

---

## Gotchas

| Issue | Resolution |
|-------|------------|
| Treating HTTP 201 as success | Several operations return 201 with a body-level outcome. Branch on `body.statusCode` (search) or `body.isSuccess` (`with-sharing-rules`), not the HTTP code. |
| `run-analyzer.isRunning` used as a signal | It is **always** `null`; the endpoint only populates `message`. Poll `get-analyzer-report` to confirm completion instead. |
| `search-archived-records-with-sharing-rules` filters as an array | `filtersJson` must be a JSON-encoded **object map** `{"Field":"Value"}`, not an array of `{field,value}`; the array form returns `isSuccess:false "No valid filters provided"`. |
| Log `url` treated as present because status is 201 | `get-*-stream-url` returns `{url}`; `url: null` means no log was resolved. Always check `url != null`. |
| Misreading `get-archive-storage-used` | `usedStorage[]`/`availableStorage[]` are parallel positional arrays: index 0=org DATA, 1=org FILE, 2=archive RECORDS, 3=archive FILE. `availableStorage[2]`/`[3]` are **always 0** (archive tier is unmetered) — that means "not tracked", not "full". |
| Expecting `ArchiveActivity` in a Flow | It is not Flow-enabled (`isProcessEnabled=false`). Use SOQL/Connect/Reports. |
| Hitting unarchive caps | Unarchive processes ≤1000 matched records per request and ≤50 requests/hour/org, and restores the whole archived hierarchy of each match. |
| RTBF/masking caps | `criteria` ≤10 entries (one per object); ≤10,000 root records/day (shared between RTBF and masking); masking is irreversible. Both RTBF and masking are gated by the same `Rtbf` user permission. |

End-to-end flow for the most common archive-admin task: find the jobs that failed or stalled, read why, and pull the logs that show which records didn't make it.

## 1. Find the jobs (query ArchiveActivity)

`ArchiveActivity` is not Flow-queryable, so use SOQL/Connect:

```sql
SELECT Id, Name, Status, Type, StartTime, ProgressPercentage,
       TotalRecordCount, SucceededCount, FailedCount, SkippedRootRecordsCount,
       RootEntityName, FailureReason
FROM ArchiveActivity
WHERE (Status = 'Failed' OR Status = 'In Progress' OR Status = 'Ended With Errors')
  AND StartTime >= LAST_N_DAYS:7
ORDER BY StartTime DESC
```

Read each row's `ProgressPercentage`, `SucceededCount`/`FailedCount`, `RootEntityName`, and `FailureReason` to summarize health. In-progress jobs have a blank `EndTime`.

## 2. For each failed job, get the logs

Take the job's `Id` (`8qv…`) as `requestId` and its `Type` as `reportType`. `{activity.Type}` below is a placeholder for that job's own `Type` field value (e.g. `Archive`, `Purge`, `Unarchive`, `Analyzer`) — substitute the actual value per job; a hardcoded/mismatched `reportType` returns no log.

**Execution-detail log:**
```text
GET /platform/data-resilience/archive/log/execution-details-stream-url
    ?requestId={activity.Id}&reportType={activity.Type}
```

**Failed-records log:**
```text
GET /platform/data-resilience/archive/log/failed-records-stream-url
    ?requestId={activity.Id}&reportType={activity.Type}
```

Each returns `{ url }`. **Check `url != null`** before using it — a `null` url means no log was resolved for that job/type (e.g. the job produced no failed-records file), not an error to retry blindly.

## 3. Summarize

Per failed/in-progress job, report: Name, Status, ProgressPercentage, SucceededCount, FailedCount, RootEntityName (target object), FailureReason, and the two log URLs (or "no log available" when `url` is null).

## Pitfalls this flow avoids

- **Not** attempting a Flow over `ArchiveActivity` (`isProcessEnabled=false` → "You can't get ArchiveActivity records in a flow").
- Passing the activity's real `Type` as `reportType` (a mismatch returns no log).
- Treating a 201 with `url: null` as a usable log.

`ArchiveActivity` is the platform entity that records **job metadata for Salesforce Archive jobs** (archive, purge, analyze, unarchive, export). Every archive job produces one `ArchiveActivity` record; you read it to learn a job's status, progress, and outcome, and you use its `Id` + `Type` to download the job's logs.

## Entity facts

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| API name | `ArchiveActivity` |
| Key prefix | `8qv` (record Ids start `8qv…`) |
| Owning product | Salesforce Archive (Trusted Services Archive) |
| Kind | **Standard platform entity** (not a custom object) |
| License gate | Requires the Trusted Services Archive add-on — absent on orgs without the add-on |
| Name field | Auto-number, mask `ARCV-{0000000000}` |
| Flow-enabled? | **No** — `isProcessEnabled=false`. A Flow "Get Records" element on it fails: "You can't get ArchiveActivity records in a flow." Query via SOQL / Connect / Reports. |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `Name` | Auto-number | `ARCV-…` job identifier |
| `Status` | enum `ArchiveActivityStatus` | Lifecycle: scheduled, running / **In Progress**, completed, **Failed**, canceled, **Ended With Errors** |
| `Type` | enum `ArchiveActivityType` | The job mode: Archive, Purge, Analyze(r), Unarchive, Export-to-external-bucket, Export-and-download. **This is the `reportType` for log downloads.** |
| `StartTime` | DateTime | When execution began |
| `EndTime` | DateTime | When execution finished/terminated (blank while running) |
| `ArchivePolicyDefinition` | Lookup (FK) | Parent `ArchivePolicyDefinition`; child relationship `ArchiveActivities` |
| `RootEntityName` | Text | API name of the target sObject being archived |
| `TotalRecordCount` | Long | Records initially selected (succeeded + failed + skipped) |
| `AttemptedRootRecordsCount` | Long (formula) | `SkippedRootRecordsCount + FailedCount + SucceededCount` — top-level records actually attempted |
| `SkippedRootRecordsCount` | Long | Top-level records skipped (validation, exclusion filters, data-protection thresholds) |
| `SucceededCount` | Long | Records processed without error |
| `FailedCount` | Long | Records that failed (validation, missing refs, exceptions) |
| `ProgressPercentage` | Double | Percent complete |
| `FailureReason` | Long text | Why the job failed/partially completed (system error messages or policy-level failures) |
| `RecordsSizeInMb` | Text | Estimated total size of processed records (MB) |

> The entity also defines a `ProgressIcon` display formula for list views; it is not useful for programmatic monitoring — read `Status`, `ProgressPercentage`, and the count fields directly.

## How ArchiveActivity links to the Connect API

The log-download endpoints (`get-execution-details-stream-url`, `get-failed-records-stream-url`) take:

- `requestId` = an `ArchiveActivity` **`Id`** (`8qv…`) of a completed, log-producing job, and
- `reportType` = that same activity's **`Type`** value.

So the monitoring pattern is: **query `ArchiveActivity` → pick the job(s) of interest → pass each job's `Id` and `Type` to the stream-url operation → check `url != null`.** See `../examples/monitor-failed-jobs.md`.

## Example SOQL

```sql
-- Failed or in-progress jobs in the last 7 days, newest first
SELECT Id, Name, Status, Type, StartTime, EndTime, ProgressPercentage,
       TotalRecordCount, SucceededCount, FailedCount, SkippedRootRecordsCount,
       RootEntityName, FailureReason, ArchivePolicyDefinitionId
FROM ArchiveActivity
WHERE (Status = 'Failed' OR Status = 'In Progress' OR Status = 'Ended With Errors')
  AND StartTime >= LAST_N_DAYS:7
ORDER BY StartTime DESC
```
